restated: An adversary with existing access to compromised Windows hosts is using remote execution or authentication mechanisms to pivot to and gain access on additional hosts in the network.
what_would_confirm: Remote logon events (e.g., 4624 Type 3/10) or service creation (7045) on target hosts originating from compromised hosts, SMB/WinRM/RDP/PsExec/WMI connections between internal hosts, use of stolen credentials or hashes across hosts, and anomalous internal east-west traffic patterns.
what_would_refute: No remote logon or service-creation events from compromised hosts to other internal hosts, no internal SMB/WinRM/RDP/WMI connections beyond baseline administrative activity, and no evidence of credential reuse across hosts.
